Started in 1882. Still building. ⛪ Watch 144 years of the Sagrada Família in 34 seconds. ⏱️

The crypt came first. Gaudí took over in 1883 and spent the rest of his life on it, but when he died in 1926 only one tower was finished. In 1936 a fire destroyed his workshop, plans and plaster models. His successors pieced them back together, then computers helped decode his geometry. The nave was roofed in 2010, the Tower of Mary got its star in 2021, and on 20 February 2026 the cross went on the Tower of Jesus: 172.5 m, the tallest church in the world.

The twist: it's still not finished.

Will you see it finished? Yes or no 👇

Next: the Leaning Tower of Pisa. Follow so you don't miss it.

First stone 1882; Gaudí took over in 1883; when he died in 1926 only one tower was complete; in 1936 his workshop, plans and models were destroyed; the Passion façade began in 1954; computers from the 1990s; nave roofed and consecrated in 2010; Tower of the Virgin Mary 2021; on 20 Feb 2026 the cross on the Tower of Jesus Christ brought it to 172.5 m, the world's tallest church. Still unfinished.
